description: A customer disputes a ₹3,200 transaction saying the same purchase was charged twice. Merchant records show two completed payments with different transaction IDs for the same order.
A customer claims a ₹22,000 payment was unauthorized. The merchant has a successful 3-D Secure authentication record and the transaction originated from the customer's registered device.
A customer disputes a ₹5,500 purchase because the delivered shoes were a different size and model from the product ordered. The order confirmation shows the originally selected size and model.

A customer disputes a ₹900 charge and says only that the transaction is unfamiliar. There is no information about whether the customer received a product, whether the transaction was duplicated, or whether the payment was actually unauthorized.

A customer disputes a ₹16,000 order claiming it was never delivered. Courier tracking shows the package was delivered to the recorded shipping address, but there is no signature or photograph confirming who accepted it.
